semiconductor_relevance: High — Shinwa Controls specializes in precision temperature and humidity control equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shinwa Controls designs, manufactures, and sells precision temperature and humidity control equipment, which is critical for maintaining optimal conditions in semiconductor fabrication. Their products are widely used in the semiconductor industry, ensuring reliability and precision in manufacturing environments.

regional_presence.Japan: Headquartered in Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan.
